python -c "
from matminer.featurizers.composition import ElementFraction
import inspect
print(inspect.signature(ElementFraction.featurize))
print('---')
# Try with a single Composition
from pymatgen.core import Composition
c = Composition('BN')
ef = ElementFraction()
res = ef.featurize(c)
print('Single Composition result:', type(res))
print('Length:', len(res))
print('First item keys:', res[0].keys() if isinstance(res[0], dict) else res)
"
